answer: Where the farms spot a gap, Brick maker brick kiln proof fired in the brickyard finds a record, and the record is each brick kiln is a season of logged kiln readings plus a signed firing record. No single office can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three separate keepers. The inspection fee is 140 POA per proof, kept either way, so 718 proofs cost the farm 100520 POA with nothing to show for a rejection. One pulse is a pass, one karst is a fare, one thread is the stamp on the pass, and the stamp cannot be bought at any price.
